local_port.description: The local UDP port number that the netconsole module will bind to for sending messages.

device.description: The ethernet device interface to send console messages out of. Leave empty to allow automatic determination.

syslog_addr.description: The IP address of the remote syslog server to send messages to.

syslog_port.description: The UDP listening port of the remote syslog daemon.

syslog_mac_addr.description: The MAC address of the remote syslog server. Leave empty to allow automatic determination via ARP.
